references.text: The earlier census of the Levites carried out by Moses and Aaron, which forms the basis for this summary count.
The Lord's command to Moses to count the Levites according to their clans and families.
The beginning of the census of the serving Levites, organized by clans.
The census of Kohath's sons carried out by Moses, Aaron, and the leaders.
The census of Gershon's sons carried out by Moses and Aaron.
The census of Merari's sons carried out by Moses and Aaron, which immediately precedes this summary.
The genealogy of Levi showing the family structure on which the census is based.
The leaders of Israel who assisted in the census, corresponding to those who helped with the Levite count.
